title: Do not embed credentials in source or configuration
summary: Credentials, private keys, long-lived tokens, and default passwords must not be stored in source-controlled files or application literals.
review_checks: Search for credential-like assignments, private-key headers, and default secrets.
Check example configuration contains placeholders rather than usable values.
safe_tests: Use synthetic markers only; never paste a real secret into a test or prompt.
Verify secret scanning catches the synthetic markers.
remediation: Use an approved secret manager or injected runtime configuration.
Revoke any exposed secret and remove it from history according to the repository policy.
